name: Ambala–Narnaul Expressway
history: NH 152D is a brand-new expressway that cuts diagonally across Haryana, from Ismailabad near Ambala in the north to Narnaul in the south. Because it was built on fresh ground away from towns, drivers can cross almost the whole state without passing through a single city. It opened in August 2022 and is now the quickest way from Chandigarh and Ambala towards Jaipur, skipping Delhi completely.
facts: Known as the Trans-Haryana Expressway; built as a greenfield road across eight districts.
Cuts several hours off the drive from Ambala towards Jaipur by avoiding Delhi.
At Narnaul it links onward towards Kotputli, forming the Ambala–Kotputli corridor.
Built under the Bharatmala programme by NHAI.
